title: Darling Yoga — Yoga Studio in Overland Park, KS
description: A sister-owned yoga studio in Overland Park since 2007. 4.8★ on Google with 112 reviews. Classes for every level, private lessons, and RYT-200 teacher training.

blocks.heading: Your Space to Breathe, Belong and Become
blocks.subheading: A supportive, inspiring, non-competitive space to move, breathe, stretch, strengthen, connect and belong.

image.alt: People participating in a yoga class, practicing downward dog pose on yoga mats in a studio

image2.alt: A woman practicing yoga on a mat in a sunlit studio with wooden floors

items.title: Get Started
items.desc: Yoga Basics, Meditate & Breathe, Chair Yoga and Iyengar Yoga for beginners of every age.

items.title: Flow & Sweat
items.desc: Mixed Level Flow, Advanced Vinyasa, Heated Vinyasa and Heated Restore & Flow.

items.title: Stretch & Restore
items.desc: Yin Yoga, Relax & Restore, Yoga Nidra and a monthly crystal-bowl Sound Bath.

items.title: Growing Families
items.desc: Prenatal Yoga, and Kid's Yoga for ages 3–11.

items.title: Y12SR
items.desc: A 12-step-based discussion and yoga practice, open to anyone touched by addiction.

items.title: Private Lessons & Events
items.desc: One-on-one sessions, corporate events, and custom yoga parties for 12 or more.

items.text: Excellent experience, the studio is very inviting with all instructors very knowledgeable and welcoming. Other students were also friendly, no one was pretentious or cold to a first-timer.
I just started yoga at Darling this spring. I am new to yoga and was not sure what to expect. What a fantastic place! All of the instructors are wonderful and so caring.
As a newcomer to yoga, I am appreciative of the gentle, patient instruction and welcoming nature of both the teachers and other students that make up this extraordinarily friendly community.
It's a wonderful place! I really love all the class options and all of the instructors are fantastic.
The location is convenient and very welcoming.

blocks.heading: Find your exhale
blocks.text: Book a class online, or stop by 20–30 minutes early to get settled.
